code_summary: Replaces SASRec with sparse item-to-item local ridge regression across all four datasets. Builds binary training histories, selects up to 128 cosine-similar neighbors per target item, and fits ridge penalties 10, 100, and 1000 using shared eigendecompositions. Selects each dataset's checkpoint by validation HR@10, breaking ties with NDCG@10. Writes sparse weights and a matching dataset-routed predictor that sums learned coefficients over unique history items. Uses provided splits and GAGC_DATA_DIR, with artifacts beneath the trial directory.
